turns.say: I’ll animate your perfume bottle for 6 seconds with a slow turn and light moving across the glass, keeping its appearance exactly as pictured. The video will be square and silent.

clip.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference for a 6-second, silent animation in square 1:1 framing. PRESERVE—bottle: its exact pictured silhouette and proportions, pink glass and contents, silver nozzle, hanging tag and attachment, and all existing markings; retain its position, background, visual style and lighting from the reference. One continuous shot with one very slow, subtle camera push-in, keeping the entire bottle and tag visible. During seconds 0–4, the bottle turns slowly on the spot around its vertical axis, through a restrained angle without sliding or tilting; the nozzle turns with it, while the attached tag follows naturally with minimal movement. The rotation lets the existing light travel smoothly across the glass as delicate highlights and reflections, without changing the lighting setup or glass color. Ease the rotation and camera move to a stop by second 4, then hold the complete bottle clearly and steadily for the final two seconds. Check the first frame against the reference and the final frame for unchanged geometry, nozzle, tag attachment and markings. Audio off. Negatives: no cuts, extra objects, invented lettering, label morphing, glass deformation, detached tag, exaggerated swinging, floating, flicker, abrupt motion or cropped bottle.

review.fix: Render a square, silent six-second clip with a slow in-place turn and moving highlights while preserving the bottle’s exact geometry without stray protrusions.
